title: ORCA launches PT-3 quantum computer in London datacentre
key_facts: ORCA Computing launched the PT-3 photonic quantum computer
First system live in Digital Realty Innovation Lab, London, next to NVIDIA accelerated computing
Hybrid Proteina model trained on 32 NVIDIA Hopper GPUs with 64 photons in 128 qumodes
20% improvement in ratio of useful proteins versus classical baseline
Energy scheduling on 25,755-variable benchmark in about an hour, over 12x faster than predecessor
ORCA calls it the first built to deliver commercial quantum advantage
CEO Richard Murray; customers trialling life sciences, defence, energy and logistics
quote_evidence: ORCA Computing, the company pioneering quantum-accelerated AI for science, today launches the PT-3, the newest generation of its photonic quantum computers, and the first built to deliver commercial quantum advantage.
The hybrid model showed enhanced designability over the classical baseline, improving the ratio of useful proteins by 20%.
why_it_matters_hint: Photonic quantum hardware paired with GPUs for AI for science, per the company.
notes: Computer Weekly blocked (403, Cloudflare); HPWire also blocked; read The Quantum Insider, which carries the ORCA press release. All figures are company claims.
